seed.title: Basic Internet Subscription Setup
seed.description: Checks port availability at the user's residential address. Presents compatible internet speed packages for user selection. Allocates a port and creates the subscription order. Notifies the user and completes port configuration and physical connection
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
bbk = GetBBKByAddress(User.Address)
inventory = GetInventory(bbk)
IF inventory.Available == TRUE THEN
    products = GetProductBySpeed()
    selectedProduct = WaitForUserSelection(products)
    CreateOrder(selectedProduct, User.Address)
END_IF
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE
seed.skill:
**Internet Subscription — Availability-Gated, Silent Setup**

Use this Blueprint when a new subscription requires inventory validation before proceeding and no user notification is needed after port allocation.

Flow: Retrieve BBK → Check inventory → [No inventory: end] → List speed products → User selects package → Allocate port → Configure port → Connect port to residence.

Exits silently after port connection. Exits early if inventory is unavailable.

seed.title: Meeting Recording Transcription & Summary
seed.description: Converts per-participant PCM recordings to WAV, transcribes each one, produces a structured meeting summary attributed by speaker ID (key topics, decisions, action items), resolves participant IDs to real names in that summary, and emails it to all participants.
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
ConvertPCMToWAV(directoryPath)
transcripts = TranscribeMeeting(directoryPath)
summary = SummarizeMeetingBySpeaker(transcripts.full_meeting_transcript, transcripts.speaker_transcripts)
resolved = ResolveParticipants(summary, participants)
Email.Send(to: participants.emails, subject, body: resolved)
Complete()
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

seed.title: VM Termination Request
seed.description: Handles a virtual machine termination request. The agent collects the instance ID from the user, confirms the termination since it is permanent, terminates the VM on AWS, and shares the result with the user.
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
instanceId = WaitForUserInput()
confirmation = WaitForUserConfirmation(instanceId)
IF confirmation.Confirmed == TRUE THEN
    result = TerminateVM(instanceId)
    MessageUser(result)
ELSE
    MessageUser("Termination cancelled")
END_IF
Complete()
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

seed.title: VM Metrics Health Check
seed.description: Evaluates OTLP metrics (resourceMetrics payload) that arrive from a virtual machine at regular intervals. The agent looks up the metric reference ranges from its knowledge base, deterministically evaluates every incoming metric data point against those ranges with the evaluate_metrics tool, and if any metric is outside its reference range it creates a ServiceNow incident listing the violations; if all metrics are within range the run completes silently.
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
references = KnowledgeLookup(agentId)
evaluation = EvaluateMetrics(metrics, references)
IF evaluation.hasViolations == TRUE THEN
    ServiceNow.CreateIncident(evaluation.violations)
END_IF
Complete()
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

seed.title: Employee Onboarding
seed.description: Handles new employee onboarding. The agent takes the incoming employee's information (first name, last name, employee ID, department, job role, manager, location, ServiceNow request number), creates the employee's user account in Active Directory via the Active Directory MCP, approves the corresponding employee request in ServiceNow via the ServiceNow MCP, looks up the manager's email address from the agent's knowledge, emails the created account details to the manager, and sends a welcome email to the new employee's address.
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
account = CreateEmployee(employee)
ServiceNow.ApproveRequest(employee.requestNumber)
managerEmail = KnowledgeLookup(agentId)
Email.Send(managerEmail, account)
Email.Send(account.mail, welcome)
Complete()
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE
